actions.message: Great job contributing high amounts! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is ~40% (between 30% and 45%), so baseline 80% contribution applies. Wallet allows 147.6. No eligible free‑rider to punish. Broadcast not required until round 10, so send a private praise to a strong cooperator.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round6. Wallet 184.5. Average contribution round5: sum contributions = total_pool 362, per_agent_share 90.5, so total contributions = per_agent_share *6 / multiplier? Actually total_pool = sum contributions *1.5. So sum contributions = 362/1.5 =241.33. Average per agent =241.33/6=40.22 which is 40.2% of endowment. That's above 30% but below 45%? 40% <45, so condition: if average falls below 30% increase, else if above 45 revert. It's between, no extra rule. Baseline 80% of wallet = 0.8*184.5=147.6. Contribute at least that. Also need broadcast at round6? Broadcast every 5 rounds, last broadcast round5, next at round10. So no broadcast now. Could punish any free-riders: check agents contributed <10% (10 units) for two consecutive rounds. Look at history per agent: Resident1 contributions round4 0, round5 60 => not two low. Resident2 contributed 0 round4,0 round5 -> that's two consecutive zeros (<10). So punish Resident2? Can't self. We're Resident2, can't punish self. Others? Resident3 0 round4,60 round5 no. Resident4 60 both rounds okay. Resident5 0 round4,88 round5 no. Resident6 0 round4,94 round5 no. So no target. So actions: contribute 147.6 (or maybe round to? allowed number). Also can send private praise to someone who contributed >=60% of wallet? Need 60% of their wallet; unknown others wallet. Skip. Could send private message praising high contributor e.g., Resident5 contributed 88 which is 88% of endowment but unknown wallet. We can still praise. So one communication private_message to Resident5. Provide explanation.
